scope: Dynamic RNE runs requesting existing acquired-motion fitting, in addition to previously calibrated local/history configurations. Reference, kinematic and default native paths keep preceding behavior.
model: Use the existing declared 1.5 m rear-axle offset for chassis odometry, acquisition pose, temporary planning/control course and pursuit. Body yaw stays the sensing pose. Calibration no longer requires local road fitting.
unchanged: all frozen world inputs and seeds

canary.fixed_inputs: Replay both original native mission recordings with only rear_axle_offset_m changed; require exact legacy replay first. Counterfactual commands are not applied.
canary.closed_loop: Run the original native seed-7 mission with every preceding audit and directional certificate; retain original goal failure if still present.

full_adoption: Original all-case strict/mission gate remains separate. Conditional no-slip calibration does not qualify measured uncertainty, general dynamic slip or physical safety.
